en:
Oh...hello, Shuichi.
Did Miu tell you to meet up, too?

Yeah... So everyone got the
same message?

She said we'd be able to get out of here, 
but this all smells really fishy...

My magical instincts are telling me 
to not get involved with Miu.

But she might have found the
only means of escape.
I think we should go...just in case.

I just remembered...how Tenko would always grab
my hand and pull me along at times like this...

<CLT=cltMIND>I can picture Tenko taking her hand
and saying, "I'll protect you!"

Alright! I'll learn from Tenko and 
move forward!

Well then, Shuichi. I'll go on ahead.
You should head over soon, too.

<CLT=cltMIND>It's a monitor for communicating with us,
but why is it so...gaudy?

<CLT=cltMIND>And it's not just the monitor,
it's this entire academy.
